changes.title: Legends north
items: When the night's won, the woken legends dance on the far side of the dancefloor, behind the conga line, so you can see the conga

changes.title: Conga finale
items: When the island is won, every animal dances the conga in its own way: trotting, hopping, bobbing, shuffling, skittering or swaying, three steps and a kick
The win's fireworks are gold, silver and rainbow, unlike any other night

changes.title: Island coast
items: The island's coast now follows the edges of its areas: headlands, coves and bays all the way round instead of a near circle
The beach, its bushes and the sea follow the new coast, and the dolphins and the kraken only show in open water
